tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: 'jam dbyangs blo ldan mchog sred sgos sgrub bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: shes rab blo dang ldan bya'i phyir: gu ru sgrub pa'i thabs la gsum: sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: sbyor rjes gnyis po sngar dang 'dra: dngos gzhi la gsum bskyed rim dang: sngags bzlas rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'o: bskyed rim dang por ma bcos gnas: stong nyid snying rje'i rang bzhin las: padma dkar ser sdong po'i steng: rang nyid blo ldan mchog sred rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung bzhugs: sku mdog dkar po dar thod can: sku la dar dkar go zu gsol: rin chen utpal spel mas brgyan: phyag g.yas thod pa'i rnga sgra sgrog: phyag g.yon pad phor bdud rtsis bkang: 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan zhi tshul can: 'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i dkyil na bzhugs: kun la bdud rtsi 'gyed par bsam: thugs dkyil pad dkar 'dab bzhi'i dbus: hrīḥdakar 'od 'phros phyogs bcur khyab: chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char bab bsam: de nas gsang ba'i snying po bzlas: bdun 'bum tsam bzla/ oṃ badzra gu ru dzñā na pra dzñā siddhi hūm̐ hrī: cu gang rgun 'brum chu dag dkar: nangs ma rigs la/ ba dmar 'o mar sbyar te btung: rdzogs rim bdag nyid hrīḥl 'dus: hrīḥyang gi gu dag la 'dus: gi gu nang 'phrad sna 'phrad zer/ khog stong nang: 'od dkar rang bzhin wa la la: mkha' mnyam bskyed la rtsol bral gnas: blo ldan shes bya kun mkhyen 'gyur: gu ru mchog sred gsang sgrub 'di: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: ྈྈྈྈྈ gu ru chos dbang rin po che'i zab gter bla sgrub gsang 'dus cha lag go// / 1$0000250༄༅// bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa las/ blo ldan mchog sred sgos sgrub khol phyung bzhugs so// 1$0000300ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐:1$0000250 shes rab blo dang ldan bya'i phyir: gu ru sgrub pa'i thabs la gsum: sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: sbyor ba la gsum skyabs 'gro dang:

sems bskyed gsol ba gdab pa 'o: skyabs 'gro sgo gsum yid dang bas: 1$0000300na mo: bde gshegs thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la: bdag sogs sems can skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed 'gro ba gzhan don du: bla ma'i rnal 'byor brtson bya bsam:1$0000250 gsol 'debs spyi gtsug bla ma bsgom: 1$0000300kye kye gu ru chen po la: sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rdzogs: bdag gi bsam pa bsgrub tu gsol:1$0000250 dngos gzhi la gsum bskyed rim dang: sngags bzlas rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'o: bskyed rim dang por ma bcos gnas: 1$0000300stong nyid snying rje'i rang bzhin las: padma dkar ser sdong po'i steng: rang nyid blo ldan mchog sred rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung bzhugs: sku mdog dkar po dar thod can: sku la dar dkar go zu gsol: rin chen utpal spel mas brgyan: phyag g.yas thod pa'i rnga sgra sgrog: phyag g.yon pad phor bdud rtsis bkang: 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan zhi tshul can: 'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i dkyil na bzhugs: kun la bdud rtsi 'gyed par bsam: thugs dkyil pad dkar 'dab bzhi'i dbus: hrīḥdakar 'od 'phros phyogs bcur khyab: chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char bab bsam:1$0000250 de nas gsang ba'i snying po bzla:1$0000300 bdun 'bum tsam/ oṃ badzra gu ru dzñā na pra dzñā siddhi hūm̐ hrī:1$0000250 cu gang rgun 'brum shu dag dkar:1$0000300 nangs ma rigs la/ 1$0000250ba dmar 'o mar sbyar te btung: 1$0000300rdzogs rim bdag nyid hrīḥl 'dus: hrīḥyang gi gu dag la 'dus: gi gu nang 'phrad sna 'phrad zer/ khong stong nang: 'od dkar rang bzhin wa la la: mkha' mnyam bskyed la rtsol bral gnas: blo ldan shes bya kun mkhyen 'gyur:1$0000250 rjes la gsum ste smon lam dang: rgyun spyod sgrub pa'i 'bras bu 'o: smon lam 'di ltar bskyar zhing gdab: 1$0000300na mo bla ma bsgrubs la sogs:

dus gsum bdag gis tshogs bsags mthus: phrin las gang brtsam myur 'grub cing: bdag sogs bla med 'bras thob shog:1$0000250 rgyun spyod bla ma'i nga rgyal gyis: gzhan don dmigs pa'i gsag sbyang bya: 'bras bu bla ma'i sa non cing: gang ltar bsam pa'i dngos grub thob: gu ru mchog sred gsang sgrub 'di: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: : rgya rgya rgya: 1$0000300 zhes chos dbang rin po che'i zab gter gyi gtso bo bla ma gsang 'dus las khol du phyung ba'o/// /
